summary.text: Peter Conlon, a Democrat from Cornwall, has represented Addison-2 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2017.
He chairs the House Committee on Education.

paragraphs.text: Conlon was raised in Montpelier and graduated from Montpelier High School and Dartmouth College, according to his House biography.
He and his wife, Mary, served as Peace Corps volunteers in Paraguay before settling in Cornwall in 1990.
He was a reporter and news editor of the Addison Independent through 2004 and then worked for nearly a decade as a dairy labor specialist throughout New England.
Since 2014 he has owned and operated Vermont Move Management and Home Inventory.
He is a member of the Cornwall Volunteer Fire Department and the Addison Central School District board.
